Name: Short Grass for Earthy Recolour
Author: stephanieisit
Description:
[center]﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/pD1d826.png[/img]﻿[/center]
I couldn't live without [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour[/url] but I also desperately wanted to see my chickens and rabbits hiding in the grass, so this is an edited version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21105]Freakycrafter's Short Grass[/url] (with permission) so it all matches up :)

[list]
[*]In order to see the shorter grass, you must uncheck [b]enableGrass[/b] in Earthy Recolour's config settings
[/list]
Includes seasonal variants and blue grass.
Grass will look slightly patchier than normal due to the fact that it is really quite short.

Credits to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/DaisyNiko?gameId=1303]DaisyNiko[/url] for the grass recolour and [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Freakycrafter?gameId=1303]Freakycrafter[/url] for allowing me to edit and reupload the original mod.
[size=1]Chicken pictured from [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20043][size=1]Elle's Cuter Coop Animals[/size][/url]
